description: Catalog of every free browser tool on TLOGZ. All tools run client-side; nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Case Converter
tools.description: Convert any text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case and more in one click.

tools.title: Word Counter
tools.description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with an estimated reading time.

tools.title: Find and Replace
tools.description: Replace every match of a word or phrase in your text, with optional case matching and regex support.

tools.title: Character Counter
tools.description: Count characters and check them against common limits for X posts, SEO meta tags, SMS and Instagram captions.

tools.title: Remove Duplicate Lines
tools.description: Paste a list and remove repeated lines in one click. The original order is kept.

tools.title: Sort Lines
tools.description: Sort lines alphabetically, numerically or by length, or shuffle them randomly.

tools.title: Text to Slug Converter
tools.description: Turn any title into a clean, lowercase URL slug with hyphens or underscores, and accents removed.

tools.title: Percentage Calculator
tools.description: Three everyday percentage calculations in one place, with results that update as you type.

tools.title: Unit Converter
tools.description: Convert length, weight, volume and temperature between common units, instantly.

tools.title: Age Calculator
tools.description: Find out exact age in years, months and days, and count down to the next birthday.

tools.title: Roman Numeral Converter
tools.description: Convert numbers from 1 to 3999 into Roman numerals, or read a Roman numeral back into a number.

tools.title: BMI Calculator
tools.description: Calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) and see the healthy weight range for your height.

tools.title: Password Generator
tools.description: Create a strong random password in one click. It is generated in your browser and never sent anywhere.

tools.title: JSON Formatter and Validator
tools.description: Paste JSON to format it neatly, compress it into one line, or check it for errors.

tools.title: Base64 Encoder and Decoder
tools.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to readable text, with full support for accents and emoji.

tools.title: Unix Timestamp Converter
tools.description: Convert Unix timestamps (epoch seconds or milliseconds) to dates, and dates back to timestamps.

tools.title: JSON to CSV Converter
tools.description: Turn a JSON array into a CSV file for Excel or Google Sheets. Your data is converted in your browser and never uploaded.

tools.title: Lorem Ipsum Generator
tools.description: Generate placeholder text for designs, mockups and websites, in paragraphs, sentences or words.

tools.title: HEX to RGB Color Converter
tools.description: Convert a HEX color to RGB and HSL, or pick a color visually and copy the values for your CSS.

tools.title: YouTube Chapter Formatter
tools.description: Turn a rough list of times and topics into YouTube chapters, and check the rules before you publish.

tools.title: WiFi QR Code Generator
tools.description: Create a QR code that lets guests join your WiFi by scanning it. The code is made in your browser.
